purchase_fms:
WITH assignments AS (
SELECT 'purchasing_owner'::text AS kind,w.project_id::text AS id,w.purchase_manager_id::text AS owner_id,w.version::bigint AS version,('Purchasing ownership · '||w.project_id::text)::text AS title,'assigned'::text AS state,'/dashboard?screen=projects&project='||w.project_id::text::text AS link,jsonb_build_array('projects.purchase_workflow.view','projects.purchase_workflow.read')::jsonb AS required_permissions,''::text AS due_date, w.project_id::text AS project_id FROM purchase_fms_workspaces w WHERE w.is_active AND w.purchase_manager_id IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'workflow_doer'::text AS kind,p.id::text||':'||(s->>'number')::text AS id,s->>'doer_id'::text AS owner_id,p.version::bigint AS version,p.code||' · '||(s->>'title')::text AS title,s->>'state'::text AS state,'/dashboard?screen=purchase-fms&project='||p.project_id::text||'&package='||p.id::text::text AS link,jsonb_build_array('projects.purchase_workflow.execute')::jsonb AS required_permissions,coalesce(s->>'planned_date','')::text AS due_date, p.project_id::text AS project_id FROM purchase_work_packages p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.steps) s WHERE p.is_active AND coalesce(s->>'state','')<>'completed' AND coalesce(s->>'doer_id','')<>''
UNION ALL
SELECT 'workflow_resolver'::text AS kind,p.id::text||':'||(s->>'number')::text AS id,s->>'resolver_id'::text AS owner_id,p.version::bigint AS version,p.code||' · '||(s->>'title')::text AS title,s->>'state'::text AS state,'/dashboard?screen=purchase-fms&project='||p.project_id::text||'&package='||p.id::text::text AS link,jsonb_build_array('projects.purchase_workflow.resolve')::jsonb AS required_permissions,coalesce(s->>'planned_date','')::text AS due_date, p.project_id::text AS project_id FROM purchase_work_packages p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.steps) s WHERE p.is_active AND coalesce(s->>'state','')<>'completed' AND coalesce(s->>'resolver_id','')<>''
UNION ALL
SELECT 'workflow_blocked_resolver'::text AS kind,p.id::text||':'||(s->>'number')::text AS id,s->>'blocked_resolver_id'::text AS owner_id,p.version::bigint AS version,p.code||' · '||(s->>'title')::text AS title,s->>'state'::text AS state,'/dashboard?screen=purchase-fms&project='||p.project_id::text||'&package='||p.id::text::text AS link,jsonb_build_array('projects.purchase_workflow.resolve')::jsonb AS required_permissions,coalesce(s->>'planned_date','')::text AS due_date, p.project_id::text AS project_id FROM purchase_work_packages p CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.steps) s WHERE p.is_active AND coalesce(s->>'state','')<>'completed' AND coalesce(s->>'blocked_resolver_id','')<>''
UNION ALL
SELECT 'hold_doer'::text AS kind,p.id::text AS id,p.doer_id::text AS owner_id,p.version::bigint AS version,'Hold · '||p.id::text::text AS title,coalesce(p.data->>'state','open')::text AS state,'/dashboard?screen=purchase-fms&project='||p.project_id::text::text AS link,jsonb_build_array('projects.purchase_holds.write')::jsonb AS required_permissions,''::text AS due_date, p.project_id::text AS project_id FROM purchase_holds p WHERE p.is_active AND (p.data->>'released_at' IS NULL OR p.data->>'released_at'='')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'hold_resolver'::text AS kind,p.id::text AS id,p.resolver_id::text AS owner_id,p.version::bigint AS version,'Hold · '||p.id::text::text AS title,coalesce(p.data->>'state','open')::text AS state,'/dashboard?screen=purchase-fms&project='||p.project_id::text::text AS link,jsonb_build_array('projects.purchase_holds.write')::jsonb AS required_permissions,''::text AS due_date, p.project_id::text AS project_id FROM purchase_holds p WHERE p.is_active AND (p.data->>'released_at' IS NULL OR p.data->>'released_at'='')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'indent_doer'::text AS kind,p.id::text AS id,p.doer_id::text AS owner_id,p.version::bigint AS version,'Indent · '||p.id::text::text AS title,coalesce(p.data->>'state','open')::text AS state,'/dashboard?screen=purchase-fms&project='||p.project_id::text::text AS link,jsonb_build_array('projects.purchase_indents.write')::jsonb AS required_permissions,''::text AS due_date, p.project_id::text AS project_id FROM purchase_indents p WHERE p.is_active AND coalesce(p.data->>'state','') NOT IN ('closed','cancelled','released','withdrawn')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'indent_resolver'::text AS kind,p.id::text AS id,p.resolver_id::text AS owner_id,p.version::bigint AS version,'Indent · '||p.id::text::text AS title,coalesce(p.data->>'state','open')::text AS state,'/dashboard?screen=purchase-fms&project='||p.project_id::text::text AS link,jsonb_build_array('projects.purchase_indents.write')::jsonb AS required_permissions,''::text AS due_date, p.project_id::text AS project_id FROM purchase_indents p WHERE p.is_active AND coalesce(p.data->>'state','') NOT IN ('closed','cancelled','released','withdrawn')
) SELECT jsonb_build_object('Source','purchase_fms','Kind',kind,'ID',id,'OwnerID',owner_id,'Version',version,'Title',title,'State',state,'Link',link,'RequiredPermissions',required_permissions,'DueDate',due_date,'ProjectID',project_id)::jsonb AS payload FROM assignments WHERE ($1::text='' OR owner_id=$1) AND ($3::text='' OR id=$3) AND ($2::text='' OR kind=$2) ORDER BY kind,id,owner_id LIMIT 10001;
master:
WITH assignments AS (
SELECT 'supplier_reviewer'::text AS kind,a.supplier_id::text AS id,a.user_id::text AS owner_id,a.version::bigint AS version,s.name::text AS title,'assigned'::text AS state,'/dashboard?screen=suppliers'::text AS link,jsonb_build_array('accounts.vendor_verification.read','accounts.vendor_verification.write')::jsonb AS required_permissions,''::text AS due_date FROM supplier_review_assignments a JOIN suppliers s ON s.id=a.supplier_id WHERE a.is_active
UNION ALL
SELECT 'supplier_document_review'::text AS kind,a.id::text AS id,a.user_id::text AS owner_id,(extract(epoch from a.updated_at)*1000000)::bigint::bigint AS version,s.name||' · document review'::text AS title,'pending'::text AS state,'/dashboard?screen=suppliers'::text AS link,jsonb_build_array('accounts.vendor_verification.read','accounts.vendor_verification.write')::jsonb AS required_permissions,''::text AS due_date FROM supplier_document_tasks a JOIN suppliers s ON s.id=a.supplier_id WHERE a.is_active AND a.completed_at IS NULL AND a.kind='review'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'supplier_document_correction'::text AS kind,a.id::text AS id,a.user_id::text AS owner_id,(extract(epoch from a.updated_at)*1000000)::bigint::bigint AS version,s.name||' · document correction'::text AS title,'pending'::text AS state,'/dashboard?screen=suppliers'::text AS link,jsonb_build_array('settings.supplier_documents.write')::jsonb AS required_permissions,''::text AS due_date FROM supplier_document_tasks a JOIN suppliers s ON s.id=a.supplier_id WHERE a.is_active AND a.completed_at IS NULL AND a.kind='correction'
) SELECT jsonb_build_object('Source','master','Kind',kind,'ID',id,'OwnerID',owner_id,'Version',version,'Title',title,'State',state,'Link',link,'RequiredPermissions',required_permissions,'DueDate',due_date)::jsonb AS payload FROM assignments WHERE ($1::text='' OR owner_id=$1) AND ($3::text='' OR id=$3) AND ($2::text='' OR kind=$2) ORDER BY kind,id,owner_id LIMIT 10001;
project_budgets:
WITH assignments AS (
SELECT 'budget'::text AS kind,p.project_id::text AS id,p.owner_id::text AS owner_id,p.version::bigint AS version,'Budget'::text AS title,'active'::text AS state,'/dashboard?screen=projects&project='||p.project_id::text::text AS link,jsonb_build_array('projects.budgets.write')::jsonb AS required_permissions,''::text AS due_date, p.project_id::text AS project_id FROM project_budgets p  WHERE p.is_active AND p.state='draft'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'budget_head'::text AS kind,p.id::text AS id,p.owner_id::text AS owner_id,b.version::bigint AS version,'Budget head'::text AS title,'active'::text AS state,'/dashboard?screen=projects&project='||p.project_id::text::text AS link,jsonb_build_array('projects.budgets.write')::jsonb AS required_permissions,''::text AS due_date, p.project_id::text AS project_id FROM project_budget_heads p JOIN project_budgets b ON b.project_id=p.project_id WHERE p.is_active AND b.is_active AND b.state='draft'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'budget_allocation'::text AS kind,p.id::text AS id,p.owner_id::text AS owner_id,b.version::bigint AS version,'Budget allocation'::text AS title,'active'::text AS state,'/dashboard?screen=projects&project='||p.project_id::text::text AS link,jsonb_build_array('projects.budgets.write')::jsonb AS required_permissions,''::text AS due_date, p.project_id::text AS project_id FROM project_budget_allocations p JOIN project_budgets b ON b.project_id=p.project_id WHERE p.is_active AND b.is_active AND b.state='draft'
) SELECT jsonb_build_object('Source','project_budgets','Kind',kind,'ID',id,'OwnerID',owner_id,'Version',version,'Title',title,'State',state,'Link',link,'RequiredPermissions',required_permissions,'DueDate',due_date,'ProjectID',project_id)::jsonb AS payload FROM assignments WHERE ($1::text='' OR owner_id=$1) AND ($3::text='' OR id=$3) AND ($2::text='' OR kind=$2) ORDER BY kind,id,owner_id LIMIT 10001;
